source._version_note: v3.12.0 is the LATEST prometheus GA (2026-05-28). Queue products MUST package the latest upstream version (owner policy 2026-06-25). v3.12.0 also clears all 5 fixable C/H of the older 3.9.x line purely upstream: grpc 1.81.1, otel/otel-sdk 1.44.0, and github.com/docker/docker (CVE-2026-34040, no v29 module fix) REPLACED by the fixed moby/moby/v2 client modules. One dep_bump remains: x/crypto 0.51.0 (v3.12.0's pin) -> latest, for 9 of its own CVEs (verdict-caught).

vendor_build._note: Run prometheus's OWN UI build (generic 'follow upstream's build'). 'make assets-compress' = check-node-version + ui-install (installs web/ui AND the separated web/ui/react-app) + ui-build + scripts/compress_assets.sh (gzips static/ + GENERATES web/ui/embed.go defining EmbedFS via //go:embed). This is what assets_embed.go (//go:build builtinassets) needs — a bare 'cp embed.go.tmpl embed.go' does NOT define EmbedFS (verified). Binaries still need build_tags=[builtinassets].
